plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Work across many Claude Code sessions: a picker to find and resume any session, snoozes that park a session until a time or until its MR moves, and a status line that names the ticket

plugins.name: cockpit-bar
plugins.description: macOS menu bar app over cockpit, forked from claude-status-bar: the spinning splat and activity text, due, running and snoozed sessions with their MRs, click to jump to the tmux pane, snooze actions
